# Zentrion Technologies – Free Cybersecurity Tools & Tutorials

> Free, browser-based cybersecurity tools and hands-on tutorials.
> No install, no signup. 20+ interactive security tools and 30+ step-by-step
> guides covering network security, AI security, pentesting, and incident response.
> Built by security professionals in India.

## Interactive Tools
- [Password Generator](https://zentriontechnologies.com/tools/password-generator): Generate cryptographically strong random passwords in the browser
- [Port Scanner](https://zentriontechnologies.com/tools/port-scanner): Scan any IP or domain for open TCP ports
- [DNS Lookup](https://zentriontechnologies.com/tools/dns-lookup): Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CAA records
- [Hash Generator](https://zentriontechnologies.com/tools/hash-generator): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashing
- [Website Security Scanner](https://zentriontechnologies.com/tools/website-security-scanner): SSL, headers, DNS, CSP audit
